scope: B0 stock-pad closure/reopen against a declared kinematic2x4 coupon; diagnostic initialization truth is not a perception pick or extraction

sequence.B0: Centered stock pad/coupon positive-reporting and actual collider inventory test only
sequence.proxy: Conditional later reviewed pad-only collision proxy; no proxy implementation/execution authorized by B0 acceptance
sequence.reserved: Fixed coupon offset +0.002m along coupon long/pad-width axis, unchanged closing width; once only after independently accepted stock and reviewed proxy development cases. No reserved feedback used to alter geometry or gates.

motion.clearance_source: Actual composed stock-pad collision planes and authored coupon surface, geometry audit before closure; not a truth-fed online grasp estimate
motion.speed_caveat: Commanded ramp is at most1mm/s; actual measured joint speed has a2mm/s sampled safety bound and is reported, not claimed to remain at1mm/s.
motion.arm: Original seven arm targets and actuator configuration held; no arm trajectory. Actual compliance/motion remains reported, not confused with a commanded trajectory.
motion.arm_actual_state: Finite actual q/qdot required; per-joint drift reported descriptively. Actual hand pose must remain within2mm/2deg of initial measurement pose; no1e-6rad rigid-arm assumption.
motion.effort_caveat: Commanded/estimated actuator effort is never counted as pad contact-force feedback.

force_response.positive_definition: Both finger-coupon SUM(abs(raw signed scalar force coefficients)) reach threshold in the same three consecutive fresh samples, with all pad-identification, raw signed f*normal/matrix/reciprocal/unit/coverage guards valid. Then stop closing and reopen.
force_response.abort_definition: Sum ALL finger-coupon normal magnitudes, regardless of pad/white classification; any value above2N stops the attempt. Preserve the first overshoot and peak. This sampled abort does not guarantee a continuous-time force cap.
force_response.all_zero: Unknown/unsupported positive reporting, never evidence of physical contact absence.
force_response.friction: Record separate friction-anchor points/vectors. No tangential-motion test, friction fitting or calibrated friction/force claim.
force_response.signed_coefficient_contract: Raw scalar coefficients may be signed according to sensor/filter orientation. Preserve raw f and n, use SUM(f*n) for vectors, SUM(abs(f)) for magnitude thresholds/hardstop, and check ownership of ALL abs(f)>1e-8N points including negative coupon coefficients. Negative coefficient alone is not invalid contact or negative physical pressure. No gain, clipping, normal flipping or tolerance adjustment.

geometry.other_finger_colliders: Every other enabled collider under each actual finger body is treated as white/other geometry; do not silently drop overlapping shapes.
geometry.before_closure: Record actual enabled collider paths, composed geometry/frames/approximation/contact/rest offsets, materials and registration. Stop if mesh_3 identity, white-vs-pad distinction or coupon initial clearance is ambiguous.
geometry.point_metric: Exact point-to-triangle surface distance in the current finger frame against composed pad and other enabled finger collider surfaces. Export actual cooked hulls if exposed; otherwise identify authored/reference approximation explicitly.
geometry.point_gate: ALL abs(raw signed force)>1e-8N force-carrying finger-coupon points in a positive frame must have d_pad <= abs(reported_separation)+50um and d_white > abs(reported_separation)+50um+0.1mm. White-compatible or unmapped points block positive classification; no favorable subset selection.
geometry.point_gate_meaning: Conservative authored-surface compatibility, not measured cooked-collider accuracy or whole-STL fidelity. A visual STL and CollisionAPI/decomposition request alone do not prove functional concavities survive cooking.
geometry.proxy_later: Only old two stock mesh_3 pad collisions may be replaced after review; white fingers, body mass/inertia and existing materials remain unchanged. A single convex hull that fills a functional notch is unsuitable.

contact_reporting.API: Existing direct PhysX tensor contact views; no convenience-wrapper stabilization mutation
contact_reporting.views: Left finger, right finger and coupon, all scene actors and standalone static collider filters; record exact resolved sensor/filter paths/order
contact_reporting.freshness: Only data after completed step and scene update, before next step; clone shared buffers before subsequent API calls. Step0 is stale and excluded.
contact_reporting.units: dt=1 query records impulses N s; actual dt query records forces N; world points/normal vectors and separate friction-anchor points retained
contact_reporting.sign: Use documented force-on-sensor pair matrices and reciprocal coupon rows. Compare point-sum normal convention with both predeclared signs; one consistent convention must agree on both pads/nonzero reciprocal pairs. Preserve raw signs and reject unresolved sign; do not fit magnitudes.
contact_reporting.completeness: All required filters resolved, valid nonoverlapping pair ranges, finite arrays, unsaturated buffers, perpoint/pairmatrix/net normal agreement and reciprocal positive pairs. A missing stream, overflow, unverified omitted pair or all-zero stream is unknown; not absence.
contact_reporting.coefficient_primary_evidence: Installed primary Isaac Sim rigid_contact_view.py example includes negative coefficients and computes SUM(force_i*normal_i); tensor API documents coefficients/normal buffers without a nonnegative guarantee. Frozen1753 records show unmodified signed products matching pair matrices, net normals, reciprocal vectors and dt scaling.

unchanged.physical_parameters: Existing native capacity/rules, mass/inertia, materials/friction, collision/rest offsets, arm/hand actuator configuration unchanged. Report authored and runtime provenance; no friction calibration or native build.

acceptance: All integrity/source/motion/sampled-limit checks plus both-pad positive and release response with valid pad compatibility/reporting. Otherwise fail/unknown explicitly; no confidence or geometry tuning from B0 data.

failed_baseline.result: First enabled stock white-finger collider mesh_0 is a Cube; Mesh-only exporter stopped before play.

execution_history.approved_round1_change: Analytic Cube representation:8corners/12triangles transformed by composed USD transform, type Cube, approximation none, analytic_cube_exact reference. Inventory all enabled collider types first. Mesh handling and every physical/scientific gate unchanged.
execution_history.remaining_execution_authorization: One reviewed R2 B0_stock attempt. No blind retry, proxy or reserved execution; three-round contact budget remains2of3 and idle-round budget remains closed.
execution_history.triangle_contract: Existing points_finger_m / triangle_indices schema unchanged; no evaluator geometric calculation change required.
execution_history.approved_round2_change: Version signed-scalar API interpretation only. Remove nonnegative coefficient validity guard; preserve signed f*normal vectors and matrix/reciprocal/dt checks, use SUMABS magnitudes and classify ALL abs(f)>existing1e-8N floor contact points. All physical/motion/geometry/0.2N3/release0.01N3/2N sampled-abort gates unchanged.

round1_result.result: Stopped on negative coupon scalar coefficients at first small contacts; signed products/matrices/reciprocity/dt consistent. Neither0.2N3positive nor release gate reached. Negative coupon point ownership was not tested under old nonnegative contract; no retrospective pass.
